title: Penguin holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='0.35' cy='0.3' r='0.7'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e02b45'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 26 Q58 40 56 52' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='17' rx='12' ry='14' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <polygon points='61,30 67,30 64,34' fill='#e02b45'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='12' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#ffc2cc' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- penguin body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#3b3f8f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='74' rx='13' ry='17' fill='#f2f3ff'/>
  <!-- left wing (holding balloon) -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q38 54 52 54' stroke='#2c2f70' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right wing -->
  <path d='M64 66 Q70 72 66 82' stroke='#2c2f70' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='60.5' r='1.5' fill='#222266'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='60.5' r='1.5' fill='#222266'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='43,66 49,66 46,71' fill='#ffb347'/>
</svg>
